key_insight: PhiBE-PI learns a single state-action critic from discrete-time off-policy data while preserving the action-ranking signal needed for continuous-time control.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports policy improvement from a fixed transition batch without explicitly estimating the system’s drift or diffusion.
method: Learn the critic directly from sampled state increments.
Alternate critic evaluation and policy improvement while reusing the same batch.
Use linear function approximation with a local end-to-end suboptimality guarantee.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical bounds tracking discretization, approximation, and finite-sample errors under data reuse, but provides no empirical results.
watch_item: Smaller sampling intervals reduce discretization error but can increase statistical error at fixed sample size, so finer sampling need not improve policy performance.
paper_title: A Model-Free Continuous-Time RL Algorithm from Discrete-Time Off-Policy Data with End-to-End Guarantees
